test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Varun can do a work in 28 days. In how many days can the work be completed by Sarvesh, if the efficiency of Sarvesh is 40% more than that of Varun?
solution:
Given:

Varun takes 28 days to complete the work.

Sarvesh is 40% more efficient than Varun.

Concept used:

Work = Units done daily × Total time taken to complete the work (in days)

Calculation:

Let Varun does Q units per day.

Total work = 28 × Q = 28Q units

So, Sarvesh daily does = Q + Q × 40% = 1.4Q

 Time taken by Sarvesh to complete the work alone = 28Q ÷ 1.4Q = 20 days

**∴ Sarvesh will take 28 days to complete the work.**

∴ Sarvesh will take 20 days to complete the work.
